details:
Q1. Which part of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. Workflow / automation behavior — name the exact phase, workflow, script, or file path in your reply (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation / README / setup guidance — name the exact file or section
C. Another area — name the exact feature or path
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix incorrect or broken behavior — describe the current behavior and the expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability / speed / cost / alert noise — describe what is too slow, flaky, expensive, or noisy
C. Add a missing capability — describe the new behavior and when it should run
Q3. What concrete evidence can you point us to?
Choices:
A. A specific issue, PR, workflow run, log excerpt, or error message — include repo + number/link if relevant (RECOMMENDED)
B. A reproducible scenario or step list
C. No existing evidence; I only have a desired outcome
Q4. What should count as “done”?
Choices:
A. A specific failing case or scenario should pass after the change (RECOMMENDED)
B. A measurable behavior should improve (for example runtime, flakiness, API usage, or alert noise)
C. A specific doc, comment, output, or label should change
